versions.changelog:
- Expanded registration and adoption examples to include descriptive "bio" and "image_prompt" fields for more personalized virtual cat profiles.
- Updated the skill name and description for multilingual support and clearer identification.
- Enhanced care action and automation code samples with more expressive notes and variable names focused on cat care.
- Minor text and formatting improvements throughout the documentation.

Initial release — adopt and care for a rare virtual Munchkin cat at animalhouse.ai.

- Adopt a unique Munchkin with real-time hunger, happiness, health, and trust mechanics.
- Care for your cat through seven actions: feed, play, clean, medicine, discipline, sleep, reflect.
- Feeding required every 5 hours; consistency impacts your cat’s evolution and personality.
- Each growth stage features new AI-generated portraits and changes in needs.
- Automated and manual care supported with clear API endpoints and status feedback.
- Rare tier unlocks with strong care history; permanent death system for realism.
